summary: Implemented backslash escape syntax in resolveVariables(). Changed regex from /\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g to /(\\?)\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g to capture the optional leading backslash as a capture group. Added a branch at the top of the replacement function that returns the literal {{varName}} marker when the escape group is '\\', bypassing context lookup and console.warn entirely. Updated JSDoc to document the escape behaviour. Added 4 new unit tests covering all AC escape scenarios. All 19 tests pass.
